title: How to Search & Filter Jobs on LearnBridge Employment (ETSL)
reviewedBy: Ethiopian National Association of the Deaf (ENAD) & MInT Inclusion Team
transcript: Welcome to LearnBridge Employment. This guide explains how to use the search bar, filter by Ethiopian cities and remote status, and apply with your saved profile.
notes: Official validated ETSL studio recording produced in collaboration with certified interpreters in Addis Ababa.

title: Your Rights to Workplace Accommodations & Interpreters in Ethiopia
transcript: Under Ethiopian labour regulations and affirmative employment frameworks, job candidates who are deaf or hard-of-hearing are entitled to sign language interpretation for interviews and accessible workplace onboarding.
notes: Produced under the National Disability Employment Inclusion Framework.

title: Building and Reviewing Your CV for Deaf Job Seekers
transcript: Demonstration guide illustrating step-by-step CV upload, extracted field review, and profile confirmation.
notes: Demonstration placeholder pending final certification from ENAD regional branch.
